A1.justification: Both complete, readable 23-page PDFs describe ADBM and contain the same main sections and Appendices A–G. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support comparison of the equations, figures, tables and appendices without material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original ADBM robustness experiments and ablations in Section 5, with additional benchmark, classifier-transfer and inference-time results in Appendices E–F.

after.justification: v4 retains the original ADBM experiments, ablations, supplementary evaluations and timing measurements in Section 5 and Appendices E–F.

M1.justification: The bridge coefficient, training loss, classifier-assisted adversarial-noise generation and inference procedure in Sections 4.1–4.3 are unchanged. The appendix corrections repair derivations without changing the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate SVHN, CIFAR-10, Tiny-ImageNet and ImageNet-100 under the same white-box, black-box, norm-bounded and additional unseen attack scenarios. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same adversarial-training and purification baselines, including DiffPure and its compared variants. The attack comparisons in Section 3 and Appendix E.1 also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Sections 3 and 5 and Appendices D–E retain the same architectures, training budgets, attack bounds, sample sizes and evaluation procedures, including the principal 200-step PGD evaluation with 20 EOT samples and five-step DDIM purification.

E4.justification: The forward/reverse-step analyses, adversarial-noise-generation ablations, alternative-attack evaluations and transfer to new classifiers are unchanged. Tables 2, 5–6, A1–A3 and A9 contain the same analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report three adaptive-attack repetitions and mean accuracies with standard deviations, with some deviations omitted for readability. Section 3 and Appendix D.2 contain unchanged reporting practices.

E6.justification: All numerical results and reported empirical findings in Tables 1–6 and A1–A10 are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains average robust accuracies of 53.5% for ADBM and 49.1% for DiffPure.

T1.justification: Appendix C.1, Eq. (19), replaces (alpha_t - bar_alpha_t)/(1 - bar_alpha_t) and the corresponding product factors with their reciprocals. Appendix C.2, Eq. (29), removes an extra (1 - bar_alpha_T)/bar_alpha_T multiplier from the expected squared residual. These correct intermediate mathematical steps; the final bridge coefficient, theorem statements and final bounds remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning ADBM, reliable adaptive evaluation, theoretical guarantees, acceleration and robustness against unseen threats.

C2.justification: The explanations of purification behavior, attack effectiveness and classifier transfer are unchanged. Section 6 and Appendices F–G retain the same computational limitations, applicability discussion and potential adverse impacts.

D1.justification: Implementation details, optimizer settings, batch sizes, software versions, GPU configuration and timing disclosures remain unchanged. The code, dataset and checkpoint access links also have identical destinations.

R1.justification: No cited work is added or removed, and research positioning is unchanged. The Li, Chen and Hu backbone-robustness citation changes from its 2023 preprint to its 2025 journal publication; other reference edits supply publication details for existing works.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp and one in-text citation year are updated. Several bibliography entries receive publication, page-range and style updates, while the prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Reference entries on page 12 are reordered and reflowed, and the corrected appendix equations produce small local spacing changes. Figures 1–2 and all main-text and appendix tables retain their structure, captions and placement.

improvement.justification: The corrections to Eqs. (19) and (29) remove local algebraic inconsistencies in the bridge derivation and Theorem 1 proof, improving the mathematical presentation. Updated reference details provide a smaller editorial benefit. The gains are limited because the method, theorem conclusions, empirical evidence and limitations are otherwise unchanged.
